completed_steps.title: Minimum Playable 3D Mountain Racer
completed_steps.summary: Three.js 3D spline road, Western Ghats scenery, procedural low-poly coupe, arcade physics, Web Audio synthesizer, mobile touch controls, HUD speedometer and Time Trial mode.

completed_steps.title: Canvas 2D Flight & Dual Lasers
completed_steps.summary: 3 starfighter classes with vector graphics, inertial movement damping, dual plasma cannons, turbo energy boost, and screen bounds.

completed_steps.title: Enemy Formations & Particle Explosions
completed_steps.summary: Sinusoidal scout dives, targeted corvette raiders, phasing stealth frigates, particle explosion system with shockwaves and sparks.

completed_steps.title: Power-Ups, Boss Fight & Retro Synth
completed_steps.summary: Smart bombs, spread lasers, rapid fire, wingman escorts, wave 5 Dreadnought Mothership encounter with radial bullet patterns, and Web Audio synthesizer.

roadmap.title: Minimum Playable 3D Mountain Racer
roadmap.description: Initial playable Three.js driving game on continuous Western Ghats spline road with dual cameras, audio synth, and HUD.

roadmap.title: Atmospheric Scenery & Rock Tunnels
roadmap.description: Add mountain tunnel passages, roadside basalt cliff overhangs, and dynamic golden-hour / monsoon weather presets.

roadmap.title: Ghost Vehicle & Split-Time Precision
roadmap.description: Record and replay translucent ghost car of player's personal best run with real-time delta (+/- seconds) at checkpoints.

roadmap.title: Canvas 2D Flight & Dual Lasers
roadmap.description: Implement the player ship, inertia movement, dual plasma laser cannons, and screen boundary collision.

roadmap.title: Enemy Formations & Particle Explosions
roadmap.description: Implement 3 enemy types with sinusoidal and dive-bomb attack patterns, collision masks, and particle burst pools.

roadmap.title: Power-Ups, Boss Fight & Retro Synth
roadmap.description: Implement shields, spread-shot upgrades, wave 5 mothership encounter, and procedural 8-bit Web Audio chiptune effects.

roadmap.title: Matrix Grid & Conduit Rotation
roadmap.description: Build interactive tile grid with straight, corner, cross, and blocker conduits supporting mouse and touch tap rotation.

roadmap.title: Signal Path Graph Traversal
roadmap.description: Implement depth-first search graph validator checking continuous circuit from energy source to targets with glowing wire pulses.

roadmap.title: 20 Authored Levels & Daily Puzzle Seed
roadmap.description: Integrate 20 curated puzzle challenges across Easy/Medium/Hard, hint assistance system, and deterministic daily puzzle seed.

roadmap.title: 3D Acrobatic Drone Physics
roadmap.description: Implement Three.js quadcopter flight model with throttle, pitch, roll, yaw, stabilized horizon, and arcade assist presets.

roadmap.title: Neon Gate Trigger Volumes & Split Timing
roadmap.description: Construct illuminated 3D racing gates with volumetric trigger detection, missed gate penalties, and lap timer.

roadmap.title: Sahyadri Ridge Drone Track & Sound FX
roadmap.description: Design an elevated mountain canyon course, directional guide arrows, synthesized propeller hum, and crash reset logic.
